A positive commutator at glancing, with variable coefficients

AN04-U063. Receiving exposition by GPT-6.1 Sol (OpenAI), Ultra. Original eligible new expression is CC0-1.0.

The normal-energy, quadratic-error and weak-commutator chapters now fit together. This chapter constructs the actual legal regularized commutants, computes their complete leading weak form, controls the incoming and elliptic cutoff errors, and proves a uniform positive estimate. The frequency regularizer is allowed to fail to commute with the equation. Its differentiated symbol is included in the error coefficients.

We use the complete current local boundary actions and commutators, actual adjoints and composition, L2 and form-domain maps, positive-order half-space bounds, and proper global calculus and both ordered parametrices. These are the earlier AN-03 proofs with their current foundation connections. The receiving prerequisites are the uniform-family and antidual rules, mixed localization estimate, normal energy and linear error, quadratic normal error and norm-specific removal, and weak commutator with its sharp lower defect. Their exact hypotheses remain in force.

The proof map records exact versions and proof locators. The elementary L2 and Cauchy–Schwarz proofs, differential, compactness and smooth-cutoff proofs, and the preceding lesson's complete weak-form actions remain in force. All coefficient families have the common compact norm supports specified there; all ordinary derivatives remain intrinsic on the Neumann domain and are supported H1 derivatives on the Dirichlet domain.

The primary route is András Vasy's paper, complete PDF pages 35–42 and 44–48, together with his complete two-page correction. The correction changes the linear normal-error scale. The argument below supplies the full receiving weak-form calculation for a smooth single boundary face, variable time coefficients and complex matrix lower terms. External paper text, images and PDF payloads are not reproduced.

12. What this closes and what still has to be translated

For the full smooth-face wave principal form and arbitrary complex matrix lower terms, the finite-order uniform positive estimate, source trade, incoming cutoff bound, elliptic guard estimate and norm-specific removal are proved above. The ordinary normal errors have the corrected unsquared and squared scales. The regularizer's nonzero commutator is represented in its complete leading coefficients and lower weak-form remainder.

The next geometric step is to relate the incoming region (PC19) uniformly to the parabolic back-flow windows in U056, and to carry the finite-order induction through a common neighborhood for smooth wave fronts. The parameter β\betaβ was retained precisely for nested cutoffs; that iteration and the exact RW4 clock/window translation are not declared proved here. Physical corners, general systems and crossings, complex-phase propagation and the full course remain active. Further pertinent, nonduplicative source integration remains active. The exact current transitive provider chain is recorded in the proof map.
